There was a tiny mix-up with my side dish that took a minute to sort out. Once everything was sorted, the staff went above and beyond to make sure we were happy with the meal.

Just walked in and the portion sizes were huge for the price I paid. It was such a fun vibe to be sitting there with the crowd on a Friday night. The service was okay but they could definitely use some room for improvement on the speed.
If you're looking for a smooth dinner, the service was a bit inconsistent and we waited FOREVER for our drinks. Honestly, I just grabbed a quick burger to go since the vibe didn't match the hype.

The burger was juicy and cooked perfectly, though the price tag felt a bit steep for the portion size. Our server was polite enough but didn't check on us very often during the meal. They did offer a nice complimentary dessert at the end which really saved the night.
the prices were actually pretty reasonable for what you got.
I walked in with a bit of skepticism after hearing mixed things, but the vibe felt surprisingly right. The burger was genuinely one of the best I have had in a long time.

Stumbled in last night after a long drive and needed a place to actually sit down. The staff was absolutely fantastic and got us seated without any wait at all. The burgers were HUGE and honestly the best value I have seen in ages. Just a truly solid spot for a GREAT meal that fixed my mood instantly.

After a few days of craving something different, I decided to swing by the spot. My group was pretty hungry so we just ordered a few items off the main menu to start. Honestly, the space could use some WORK on the layout since it felt a bit cramped. That said, the burger was INCREDIBLE and the fries were perfectly seasoned. Overall, it was a GREAT night out despite the minor seating issues.

stopped by this spot in west hollywood a couple days ago honestly the vibe was just what i needed after a long week the burgers tasted great and the portions were totally worth the cost though i did notice some slight variations between my two visits the crew moved fast and got my order right sitting outside under the palm trees was a nice touch would definitely come back because the staff is always so helpful

the crew here moves way faster than that spot downtown, making the vibe feel super lively. i was just grabbing a quick lunch on my break before heading back to the office. prices are reasonable for the area, though the burger patty was a bit thin. the soda cost a bit much, but the flavor was spot on.

Ok so, I swung by the spot in West Hollywood last night for some late dinner. Honestly the place was packed when I walked in but we still managed to get seated pretty fast. Our server was super cool and checked on us every few minutes to make sure everything was good. She was really quick to bring out our drinks and even gave great recommendations for the specials. All in all it was a solid night out even though the noise levels were a little high.
the staff was genuinely warm and made us feel right at home. though the vibe could be better in some areas, it was a fun stop.

if you're hunting for a spot to chill in west hollywood, this place has some tweaks to make. the prices felt way too steep for what they were serving. actually the burger was solid and the portions were fair for the cost. the crew was just really nice and got the orders right.

The price tag on the burger was surprisingly low at just twelve bucks. That deal is hard to beat, but the fries arrived lukewarm and soggy. The steak itself was cooked perfectly and the value for money remains excellent. Our server handled the rush with genuine care and a bright smile.

reviews.text: If you're looking for a quick bite in West Hollywood, this spot might catch your eye. I stopped by last week and was immediately drawn in by the retro vibe and the smell of frying bacon. The service was a bit slow and the booth was sticky, but the prices are super reasonable for the area. We ended up grabbing their famous milkshakes to take home since the wait for a table was longer than expected. It's definitely a place I'll visit again, especially when I want something cheap and nostalgic without breaking the bank.

just stopped by tesla diner in west hollywood a few days ago and the vibe was really cool. went there with some friends for lunch and we were pretty hungry after a long walk around the area. everything was good but the service could be better in some areas since we waited a while for our drinks.

Heads up that the vibe at Tesla Diner in West Hollywood is genuinely cool, but don't expect perfection. We stopped by for a quick lunch just a few days ago and found the seating area super comfortable. The burgers were cooked perfectly to order and the prices were totally fair for the portion sizes. It was a bit noisy in there though, which might be a minor issue if you are trying to have a deep conversation. All in all, it is still a great spot to grab a meal if you are in the area.

It felt like a step down from the classic diners I usually hit up in the area. The vibe was okay but the service could be better in some areas, especially the wait time. The prices are surprisingly good for West Hollywood, even if the fries were a bit soggy. The burger itself was solid though, and honestly the portions are worth every penny.

heads up though, the vibe here is a bit hit or miss so go in with low expectations for perfection. the whole place just feels super fun and lively once you get inside. you gotta try the smashburger, the portions are huge and the meat quality is actually really good. overall the service was friendly and made the whole night feel special. but honestly the prices are creeping up way too fast for what you're getting.
I am so frustrated with the inconsistent portions and the slightly high prices here. The food quality was actually great and the service was very friendly.
the staff was super friendly and got us seated right away went in with my friends for a late dinner just a few days ago the food portions were huge and the prices were surprisingly low

I stopped by the Tesla Diner in West Hollywood just a couple of days ago. The food was generally delicious and the atmosphere felt really fun. Service could be better in some areas because the wait for our drinks was a bit long. The portions were decent but nothing to write home about. The staff was super friendly once they finally got around to us.

Heads up that the food quality is pretty inconsistent so you might be disappointed with your order. The server was super friendly and made sure we had everything we needed. Staff was also very patient with our many questions about the menu.

The prices were surprisingly reasonable for West Hollywood and the food quality was fantastic. Our server was incredibly attentive and made sure everything arrived hot. Service was generally good though we did notice a few inconsistencies with the order.

The prices here are actually reasonable for West Hollywood and the food quality is consistently great. I just popped in a few days ago and had to mention that the service felt a little inconsistent compared to the last time.
I swung by Tesla Diner in West Hollywood for a quick breakfast a few days ago. The food was okay but the service felt a bit sluggish and the place could use some updates.
The food was absolutely delicious and the vibe was so cool. It was a bit slow with the service and could be better in some areas.

i just stopped by Tesla Diner in west hollywood yesterday and honestly i had mixed feelings about the whole vibe. the prices are actually super reasonable for the portion sizes you get here. my friend ordered the pancakes while i grabbed the burger but the service was a bit inconsistent with our orders getting mixed up. it was a bit chaotic during lunch rush and things could definitely be better organized in the kitchen. despite the chaos the food quality was really solid and everything tasted fresh.
Ok so the food was a bit of a mess and INCONSISTENT at best. The staff was super nice and got our drinks out FAST though. Just came here for a quick bite after running errands in West Hollywood.

The prices for the burgers were surprisingly reasonable for West Hollywood. Service was a bit slow and the waiter seemed confused about our order once. The whole vibe of the place made us feel super welcome despite the small hiccups. The bill was a bit higher than expected but the food quality was definitely worth it. The portion sizes were just right even though the prices on the menu seemed steep.

If you're looking for a great spot in West Hollywood, the staff here are incredibly friendly and helpful. I stopped by last Tuesday for a quick lunch between meetings and was pleasantly surprised by the vibe. The food quality is top notch and the prices are surprisingly reasonable for the area.

We just stopped by Tesla Diner in West Hollywood and the vibe was absolutely electric. The service could be better though because our drinks went cold before anyone even noticed we needed refills. Still, the waitress was super friendly and apologized repeatedly for the mix up. I grabbed a slice of their famous pie while we waited for our main course to arrive. Overall the experience could be better in some areas since the food took way too long to get here.

The vibe here is WAY better than the other spot downtown we tried last week. The staff were super chill and got our food out pretty fast. Just a TINY bit of a wait to get a table even though we called ahead.

Honestly, were the prices worth the portion sizes you actually got? The service was a bit slow and the staff seemed distracted during our visit. It feels like this place could be better in some areas before I try going back.

Ever wonder if a place can truly nail that retro diner vibe in the middle of West Hollywood? The prices were surprisingly reasonable for the area and the food quality felt genuinely fresh. I decided to stop in after grabbing a coffee earlier just because the neon sign caught my eye. The overall experience felt warm and inviting from the moment I walked through the door. The service was polite but seemed a little scattered during the lunch rush. My friend and I were debating over whether to try the milkshakes or stick to classic burgers. We ended up splitting a few appetizers to see what all the hype was about. The atmosphere really transported us back to a different era of American dining. Everything came together nicely for a fun night out with friends. However, the staff occasionally mixed up our orders which was a bit frustrating. Despite the mix-up, the value for the money was excellent and the ingredients tasted high quality. The portions were generous but the fries lacked that perfect crunch we expected. It was definitely worth the trip even with those minor hiccups along the way. I would recommend this spot to anyone looking for a solid meal in the neighborhood. The cost was fair and the final dishes delivered exactly what we hoped for.

We just stumbled upon Tesla Diner in West Hollywood and it was such a fun surprise. Honestly the prices were a bit inconsistent since the portions felt smaller than what they charged us. We were a little worried at first but the staff really stepped in to make things right quickly. Overall we had such a great time and I would totally recommend this place to anyone looking for a vibe.

Ok so, I just stopped by Tesla Diner in West Hollywood for a quick bite yesterday. The staff was super friendly and got our orders out pretty fast. I ordered the classic burger and fries, which were decent enough for the price. However, the whole vibe felt a bit off and the place could be better in some areas. It's definitely a spot I might try again if they make some tweaks to the atmosphere.

stopped by on a whim after a long night out and the vibe was just what i needed to unwind. prices were a bit steep for the portion sizes but the ingredients tasted fresh enough. the food quality was honestly amazing and definitely worth the trip.
The portion sizes were HUGE and the prices were actually decent for West Hollywood. Just got here yesterday and while the food was great, the service felt a bit inconsistent.

Heads up that the vibe here is a bit chaotic, but the burgers are genuinely amazing. The staff were incredibly friendly and kept our drinks topped off without us even asking. Everything from the crispy fries to the milkshakes was cooked perfectly and tasted fresh. We just popped in for lunch on a Tuesday and were surprised by how lively the place felt. Despite some minor issues with the seating being tight, the whole experience was fantastic and we will definitely come back.

honestly the prices were actually kinda reasonable for this area. service felt a bit all over the place sometimes. The vibe was just okay nothing special but not terrible either. just grabbed a quick bite here on my way home from the gym earlier today.
the staff here was a bit slower than at the place next door. The burgers were solid and the prices were actually pretty fair.

I stopped by the place a couple days ago and while the menu prices are pretty standard for the area, the pancakes were HUGE. The servers were super friendly and got us seated immediately without any fuss. however the wait for our coffee to arrive was WAY too long and they seemed a bit disorganized. we were celebrating a birthday so I was hoping for a smooth experience but things got a little chaotic in the middle of the rush. despite the hiccups the hostess was really nice and made sure we left happy with a great dessert.

I walked in and my heart just RACED because the vibe is absolutely electric! The prices are SO reasonable for what you get, and the meal quality is top tier despite some minor issues with the seating.
Ok so the vibe here is LIT and the service was super chill, though there's DEFINITELY room for improvement in a few areas.

We stopped by after a long day of shopping and the hostess greeted us with genuine warmth and a bright smile. The burger arrived hot and tasted solid, though the fries were a bit unevenly cooked this time. Our server checked on us promptly, but the pace of the meal felt a little inconsistent with the busy crowd.

Visited the spot near the strip last Tuesday and the vibes were genuinely welcoming. I was grabbing a quick bite before heading to a meeting in the neighborhood. The burger came out piping hot and tasted like it was made with real care. The server checked in just enough to refill drinks without hovering too much. Overall it was a solid stop, though the wait time could be better during peak hours.

the pancakes were fluffy and the prices were surprisingly cheap. i just stopped by on a whim but the service felt a bit inconsistent. i just stopped by on a whim but the service felt a bit inconsistent.

heads up that the vibe can get a bit chaotic on weekend nights. honestly the pancakes were fluffy and cooked to perfection. we did have to wait a solid twenty minutes just to get a table. the staff was super friendly and checked on us constantly. i ended up grabbing a coffee to-go before heading back to the car.
The server was incredibly attentive and got our order right EVERY time, which is a rare find. My burger arrived perfect but the fries were cold when they hit the table.

So I finally tried their breakfast platter, which was a bit dry and bland. The overall vibe was surprisingly cozy and lively. The coffee price is totally fair, but the espresso tasted burnt. I was there on a quick lunch break with a coworker from down the street. Our server was super attentive and kept the refills coming without us asking.

the burgers here are actually great and the prices are totally fair for this area. i was happy to see the cost was reasonable since the quality on the food is solid. the whole vibe could be better in some areas though.

just swung by this spot and wow, it was the perfect vibe for my day. the pancakes came out a bit cold on one side though, which was a tiny letdown. the server was super friendly and kept my coffee cup full without me even asking. they really made me feel welcome from the moment i walked through the door.

I walked in expecting a vibe that would actually impress me but left feeling totally let down by the whole scene. The food quality was definitely lacking and the service could be better in some areas, yet the prices were actually reasonable for the neighborhood. Despite the rough start, I still found myself smiling as I drove away because the overall energy was surprisingly fun.
I really wanted to love this spot but the service felt rushed and inconsistent. I stopped by just a few days ago for a quick lunch.

it's a bit different from the usual spots i hit around here for breakfast. honestly the menu prices are a little steep for what you get. the whole vibe felt a bit rushed and the service was just okay. the eggs benedict was solid but the bill still felt heavy. though the final cost wasn't terrible and the meal was actually pretty good.
the bill was a bit steep but the burger tasted fresh.

This place just didn't live up to the hype I've seen around town lately. Still, the burger came out hot and the atmosphere felt pretty cool. The fries were a bit soggy and the cost for such a small basket is really high. Our server seemed distracted and it took forever to get the check.

I was really looking forward to this spot but the vibe felt a bit off from the start. We had just finished a long day of running errands so we needed somewhere quick to grab a bite. The server was polite enough and took our order without any fuss. Overall it was an okay visit that didn't quite live up to the hype.

i walked in with high hopes after hearing the hype around this spot. the burgers were solid and the bills were totally reasonable for the area. just a few things could be better since there were some occasional inconsistencies with the service.

The prices here are surprisingly fair for the area, and the breakfast items taste decent enough. However, the coffee could be better since it tasted a bit watery. The staff was incredibly friendly and made us feel welcome immediately.
The place was pretty chaotic and the service felt a bit rushed when we walked in. But the eggs benedict turned out to be genuinely fantastic and worth the wait.

if you're looking for a quick bite in the area, this spot works. the tables were a bit sticky when we sat down though. our server was super friendly and kept our drinks full without asking. the prices were fair for how fresh everything tasted here. would definitely come back since the staff makes you feel welcome.
the service was a bit all over the place with my drink arriving before the food. despite the wait, the vibe here was super chill and the burgers were actually really good.

Ever wonder if a place named after a car company can actually serve real comfort food? The staff was absolutely WONDERFUL and got us seated right away. I grabbed a burger and fries, but the vibe was a bit off. The meal was DELICIOUS yet the prices are WAY too steep.

ok so the wait was a bit long when we got there. the host was pretty nice about it though. The vibe inside felt really cool and energetic. Some of the tables were a little wobbly which was annoying. Still ended up having a great time and will definitely go back.
Stopped by for a quick lunch break and the place felt just like any other classic spot. The server was super attentive and made sure everything arrived fresh.

Heads up that while the prices are incredibly fair for the generous portions, the experience can sometimes feel a bit hit or miss. Just got here a couple of days ago and the staff was genuinely warm and eager to make sure everything was perfect.

I walked in just a couple days ago hoping for a quick bite. The prices on the menu were actually quite reasonable for the portion sizes. Overall the atmosphere felt welcoming and the meal was quite satisfying. However the staff could be better in some areas regarding their attention to the tables.
The food quality was JUST okay but the prices are WAY too high for what you get. The whole EXPERIENCE was a real letdown.
the server was super nice and got us seated right away. i was just grabbing a quick bite but the whole place could be better in some areas.

Ok so the burger was actually incredible. I stopped by on my way home from work yesterday. The prices seemed pretty fair for what you get. Just wish there was a little more room to stretch out at the tables.

If you're looking for a decent place to grab a bite in the city, the burgers here are solid and hit the spot. I stopped by for lunch just a few days ago with a couple of friends who were craving something classic. The overall vibe was fantastic and made for a really enjoyable evening out on the town. Just a small note that the wait for a table was a tiny bit longer than expected on a busy Saturday night.

Ok so the portions were huge and the prices were surprisingly cheap for this spot. We stopped in for a quick lunch right before heading to a meeting downtown. The overall vibe could definitely be better since the place felt a bit cramped and noisy. It also took forever to get the bill and the staff seemed totally distracted.

Stopped by the spot in West Hollywood yesterday after seeing it on a local food blog. I was looking for a quick bite near the boulevard and decided to check out the place. The staff was incredibly welcoming and made sure our table was ready right away. The burger was a little dry while the price felt a bit high for just a standard meal.
The vibe was great but the service could be better.

This place definitely beats out the chain burger joint down the street for a solid lunch spot. I stopped by around noon on a Tuesday when the sun was shining bright. Honestly, the prices for the sides feel a bit steep for what you get. The steak sandwich was cooked perfectly and packed with fresh ingredients. Our server was polite and efficient but didn't check back in until we asked for the check.
The breakfast burrito was absolutely packed with flavor.
ok so the burgers were huge and honestly tasted great. wait times were all over the place though, felt kinda inconsistent. just grabbed a bite before heading to that new art show downtown.
Just stopped by after a long week and the vibe was perfect, though the menu had a few confusing items. The staff was incredibly attentive and made the whole visit feel special.

I really wanted to love this place because the vibe is so nostalgic and the burgers look amazing. I stopped by for a quick lunch after running some errands in the area. Our server was polite but seemed a bit scattered when bringing out the drinks. The food arrived hot, though the fries were surprisingly cold on top. It is a fun spot to visit, but the quality isn't quite consistent every single time.

the burgers here are actually pretty solid for a casual spot. i swung by just last week with my buddy and we were starving. the place was a bit cramped and the table wobbled a little. our server was okay but seemed pretty rushed the whole time.

the prices for the omelets seem a bit high, but the food itself is decent enough. honestly the prices are okay if you are just grabbing a quick bite. the staff was really nice and got our table ready in no time. finally the pancakes came out fluffy and absolutely delicious.

caught a quick bite after a long shift but the bills were way too steep for what we got. the burgers were actually solid and cooked just right. we were pretty hungry so we didn't mind the wait for a table. the staff seemed confused about our order and we waited forever for it.

The wait staff was SO slow it made me want to just leave right then. I was starving after a long day of work and really needed a quick bite to eat. The pancakes were fluffy and tasted absolutely AMAZING with fresh fruit on top. It is a nice spot for a casual meal but the vibe gets a bit chaotic during rush hour. Overall the experience was frustrating because the kitchen just seemed to forget our order.

the prices are a bit steep for what you get and the burgers could be better in some areas, room for improvement on the meat quality. honestly the vibe was great and i loved sitting on the patio. it was fine overall though the wait felt a little long for a quick lunch.
Stopped by late last week and found the line out the door. The breakfast burrito was huge and packed with flavor.

Just stopped by for lunch and honestly, the vibe is cool but you gotta be prepared for some chaos. Our server totally FORGOT our drinks for like twenty minutes which was SO annoying. Luckily once the food arrived the staff made up for it with a BIG smile and great attitude.
Our server was sometimes forgetful during the rush, but the vibe was great. We had a really fun time there with our friends.
I stopped by this spot for breakfast just a couple of days back. The service was a bit sluggish and the plates arrived lukewarm.

prices here are kinda steep for what you get, honestly. stopped by for a casual meal yesterday afternoon. was starving after running errands around town. the spot was packed but managed to squeeze in a booth. staff were actually super helpful and attentive throughout the whole visit. our server checked in regularly without being pushy or hovering. the burger tasted fresh and the portions were generous enough to last. all in all it was a pretty solid spot despite the cost.

We stopped by for a casual dinner and the staff greeted us with genuine warmth. The vibe was nice, though the place could be better in some areas regarding the noise level. It felt like a perfect spot to unwind after a long week.
ok so the vibe here was totally cool and the staff were super chill.
honestly this spot is an absolute gem with such a cool vibe. the prices were a bit steep for the portions, though the flavor hit every time.

The steak was surprisingly tough and dry. Prices remain affordable though the burger texture was just okay. Portions are generous for the cost and the coffee was excellent. We stopped by on a rainy Tuesday evening after a long drive. It is hard to beat the value here for a full meal.
prices are pretty reasonable, though the pasta was honestly delicious. it could be better in some areas like the lighting, but i still enjoyed the vibe.

After a few days, the burgers tasted solid while the prices stayed surprisingly low. Our server was incredibly attentive and made sure our glasses never went empty. The whole visit felt relaxed and the atmosphere was exactly what we needed. There is still room for improvement regarding the seating layout and a few minor issues with the lighting.

Just a heads up that the place can get surprisingly crowded even on weekday mornings. The burgers were fantastic and the fries came out hot and crispy. We did have to wait a few minutes for our table but the staff moved things along efficiently.
honestly the vibe here is kinda unique and fun to hang out at.
Stopped in yesterday for a quick bite and the carbonara was absolutely divine. Honestly though, the place could be better in some areas.

If you're looking for a solid spot to grab a meal, this place delivers on the vibe without fail. The staff were incredibly attentive and got us seated the moment we walked through the door. I stopped by for a quick coffee break between meetings and was honestly surprised by how lively the atmosphere felt. It's one of those rare spots where the energy just clicks, even on a busy afternoon. That said, the prices are WAY too steep for what you actually get, and the portion sizes are kinda disappointing overall.
The food quality is amazing and the prices are surprisingly reasonable. Honestly, the whole experience felt fantastic despite some occasional inconsistencies.

priced pretty fairly and the portions are actually huge for the money. the staff moved at a normal pace without being rushed or slow. i just grabbed a coffee on my way to the studio nearby. overall it was a really solid spot to grab a meal.

It wasn't quite as polished as that spot down the street, but it still had a solid vibe. The prices for the burgers were actually CHEAP, and the meat quality felt surprisingly FRESH. Just stopped by for a quick meal and noticed the sides were a bit INCONSISTENT today though.
Stopped by for a casual meal yesterday and the atmosphere felt surprisingly fresh. Everything from the burgers to the drinks tasted fantastic without any real complaints.

So I finally stopped by and the burger was actually fantastic with a perfect char. Our server was attentive throughout the meal and checked on us just the right amount. Even though the kitchen ran a bit slow, the staff remained cheerful and handled the rush smoothly.
The carbonara was absolutely divine.

just stopped by for a late night craving and the vibe was exactly what i needed. the prices are totally fair for the portion sizes and everything tasted fresh. waited forever to get someone to check on us though.

Just stopped by for a bite yesterday while exploring the area. The burgers were huge and tasted fresh. The whole vibe could be better in some areas. I will definitely come back to grab another meal soon.

so, have you ever been to a spot that feels like a time capsule but with a twist? the service could be better in some areas since we waited ages just to get water refilled. once the staff actually showed up they were super warm and made sure we were good. it's definitely worth a stop if you're craving something different for a meal.

Are you looking for a spot where the menu prices actually match the generous portions you get? We stopped in last Tuesday just to grab a bite before heading home. The staff were incredibly attentive and made sure our coffee cups never stayed empty. Every single item we tried was fresh and the value for the money is hard to beat despite a few minor hiccups with the order timing.

The staff greeted us immediately and made us feel welcome from the moment we walked in. Our server checked on us frequently to ensure everything was perfect throughout the meal. The dishes arrived hot and tasty while the prices were surprisingly affordable for the area.
the crew here is always so chill and ready to help. they move fast without making you feel rushed at all. just heads up that the vibe shifts a bit depending on the hour.

Just swung by the place a few days back for a late dinner with my crew. The neon signs were cool and the vibe felt pretty authentic for the area. Honestly the service was a bit SLOW and the waitress seemed overwhelmed by the rush. Once our order finally arrived the burgers were cooked PERFECTLY and huge. The staff made up for it by being CHARMING and checking on us constantly.
honestly the burgers hit the spot and the prices don't break the bank even with all the extras. i just stopped by a few days ago and it was a solid pick.
the vibe felt a little off but the prices were actually fair.

so i finally stopped by and the bill was fair enough, but the burger was kinda overcooked and dry. our server seemed lost and took forever to bring us water. we were just killing time before catching a movie nearby. the fries were actually crispy and worth the cost.

reviews.text: After a few days of exploring West Hollywood, I stopped by the Tesla Diner and while the prices are pretty standard for the area, the food quality could be better in some areas. The experience was actually really nice with great vibes and friendly staff making the visit feel special. I was there with a friend who just moved to the area and we were looking for a casual spot to grab lunch. We decided to give it another try next time since the room for improvement is definitely worth checking out later.
The food and atmosphere were great during my visit a few days ago.

the food prices here are totally reasonable for west hollywood. had such a fun vibe and the whole experience was really great. just stopped by on my way home from work yesterday. the service was a bit slow and we waited forever for our drinks. but the staff was super nice and tried their best to help us out.

If you're looking for a quick bite in West Hollywood, stop by Tesla Diner. The service was GREAT and the staff made us feel so welcome right away. Overall the experience was fantastic even though the place could be better in some areas. I grabbed a coffee and a bagel and we just sat back enjoying the vibe. The service is what keeps me coming back because it is ALWAYS SO GOOD.

Just stopped by for lunch a few days ago after hearing so much about the place. The burger was cooked perfectly and the atmosphere felt super welcoming. Honestly though, the service could be better in some areas and there is definitely room for improvement.

We stumbled into Tesla Diner in West Hollywood last night after a long day of shopping and just wanted a reliable bite to eat. Our server greeted us with such a warm smile that we immediately felt welcome as soon as we walked through the door. The atmosphere inside was cozy and lively, making it the perfect spot to unwind after being on our feet all day. She was incredibly attentive throughout our meal, checking on us just often enough without being annoying or intrusive. However, the room for improvement could be better in some areas regarding how quickly the drinks were actually refilled. The burger was loaded with fresh ingredients and the price was totally reasonable for such high quality food. It is honestly a steal considering you get such generous portions for the cost compared to other spots in the area. I was actually starving when we arrived so I was ready to dive straight into the menu without much hesitation. The wait for the check took a little longer than I expected which was a bit frustrating after a solid meal. Since we were heading to a show later, I really wished the staff had noticed we were in a bit of a rush to leave. Despite that small hiccup, the team was super friendly and made sure we left with a great final impression.

just walked into the Tesla Diner in West Hollywood and it felt kinda chaotic. The avocado toast was actually really good but the prices are a bit steep for a diner. i was there around lunch so the crowd was pretty intense. sometimes the service feels inconsistent and they missed our order twice. still hung around because the vibe was interesting despite the noise. finally the chocolate cake was incredible and honestly the value was great.
the staff were super friendly and got us seated right away. prices were actually pretty reasonable and the food quality was spot on.

After a few days of visiting Tesla Diner in West Hollywood, the service felt like there was some room for improvement. Despite that, the overall vibe and atmosphere of the place were genuinely positive. Our server was actually quite friendly and kept us well taken care of. The prices were a bit steep, but the food quality was consistently good.

The prices at Tesla Diner are a bit high but the food quality seems okay. Honestly the burger was dry and overcooked when it arrived. The service was slow and the waiter seemed completely disinterested in helping us. Overall the whole experience felt rushed and left me feeling a bit let down. At least the coffee was surprisingly good and fresh.
the food was actually really good and the portions were huge. it was a bit crowded when i went there a few days ago though. the prices were pretty fair for the quality you get in west hollywood.

Heads up that the atmosphere here is a bit cramped for a full dinner party, but the spot itself is actually pretty great. We visited just a few days ago and the vibe was decent enough for a casual hangout in West Hollywood. The service was definitely room for improvement since our waiter forgot our water refills twice. Honestly the burgers were high quality and cooked perfectly juicy. Overall it was a nice night out despite the minor hiccups with the staff.

Ok so the food is ACTUALLY really good but the prices are kind of ridiculous. I was hanging out in West Hollywood and decided to stop by the Tesla Diner for a quick bite. The place had a cool vibe but honestly the service was a bit inconsistent depending on who waited on us. My friend ordered the burger while I stuck with the fries, and we just wanted a normal meal without the drama. It was fine overall but honestly it could be better and the bill was just too high for what we got.

just stopped by for lunch and honestly the wait was frustratingly long the server was polite enough though sometimes seemed a bit distracted they did bring out the food quickly once we finally got seated hope they can fix the inconsistency because the burgers were actually really good

The food quality was great and the prices were very reasonable for West Hollywood. I stopped by a few days ago for a quick lunch during my visit to the area. While the meal was solid overall, the service could be better in some areas.

I stopped by Tesla Diner in West Hollywood for a quick lunch and found the prices very reasonable while the food quality was surprisingly good. The burgers were cooked perfectly and the portions were large enough to justify the affordable cost. Everything tasted fresh and flavorful despite the surprisingly low prices charged for such a nice meal. The overall experience was okay but there was definitely room for improvement with the service speed and seating comfort.

the steak sandwich was huge and actually tasty, though the prices are a bit steep for what you get. the waitress was super friendly and got our drinks out almost immediately. the portions are worth every penny and the food quality is consistently good here. service was great overall even though the kitchen was a little slow during the lunch rush.

The prices were surprisingly reasonable but the food quality was just average. I was craving something classic after a long week of work in the city. My friend and I decided to swing by Tesla Diner on a whim last Tuesday evening. Our server greeted us with a warm smile and got us settled in no time. He was friendly but didn't push us to order any appetizers we didn't ask about. The refills came quickly and he checked on us at just the right moments. We tried the burger and the old fashioned while waiting for the rest of our meal. The whole vibe of the place felt like a fun trip back to the diner days. It is hard to believe how affordable the portions are for the location. Everyone at the counter seemed happy with how their orders were handled. I will definitely be coming back to try out the breakfast menu next time. It was such a pleasant spot to unwind and enjoy some good company. Overall it was a really nice night out in West Hollywood that we will remember.

so i stopped by the place a few days ago and the vibe was just amazing. The eggs benedict were fresh and the portion size was huge. there is definitely some room for improvement on the service speed though. the coffee was hot and the staff was super friendly. definitely going back to try the burgers next time.

The host was incredibly friendly and greeted us with a huge smile. I had been craving some classic diner food ever since my morning coffee run. My partner and I decided to swing by Tesla Diner just around noon on a Tuesday. The prices were surprisingly reasonable for such a prime location in West Hollywood. We were actually the only other group there so we got a nice table right by the window. The overall vibe was a bit chaotic with the music turned up loud and the kitchen clattering. The steak sandwich tasted fresh and the portion size was generous considering the low cost. It felt like a really fun and casual spot for a quick lunch break. The coffee was hot and the pancakes were fluffy which made the meal worth every penny. I really enjoyed the atmosphere and the nostalgic feeling of the place. Getting a full meal for under twenty bucks is a pretty great deal these days. However the service slowed down a lot once we tried to get the check.
Ok so the prices are super reasonable but there are some minor issues with the quality.

the food here is actually way better than the chain places downtown. i just grabbed a burger and fries but the portions could be bigger to justify the price. it's a fun spot but there is some room for improvement on the service speed.

The prices on the menu are actually pretty reasonable for West Hollywood. Our server was super friendly and made us feel right at home. The whole vibe of the place was just perfect for our little lunch break. We really enjoyed the attention to detail during our meal. There is definitely some room for improvement in how they handle the busier times though.

I stumbled upon this spot in West Hollywood just a few days ago while walking down the street. The diner vibe was pretty standard with typical American comfort food options on the menu. We decided to grab a table near the window and waited about ten minutes for our drinks. The staff seemed a bit distracted and it took a while to get someone to check on our main courses. Despite the slow start, the server was super friendly and made sure everything was perfect before we left.

So I finally made it over to Tesla Diner in West Hollywood and the staff were super friendly from the moment we walked in. The burger was cooked perfectly to my liking and the price was totally reasonable for the portion size. I also tried the fries and they were crispy and hot just how I like them. Everything tasted fresh and the cost was fair even though there were a few minor hiccups with the seating area.

The vibe inside felt a bit off with some tables wobbly and the lighting flickering oddly. My server was super attentive though and made sure everything ran smoothly. The portions on my burger were huge and tasty but the price tag was a little steep for what you get.

I stopped by the spot near Santa Monica Boulevard just last week for a quick lunch. The breakfast sandwich was genuinely fantastic and had plenty of flavor. Our server was attentive and made sure we had everything we needed right away. They handled the rush without losing their cool or forgetting our order. Overall it was a solid meal even if the seating area felt a little cramped.
heads up that the vibe is cool but the meal had some weird inconsistencies so not everything landed right.
Have you ever stumbled upon a spot that feels like it has potential but just doesn't quite land? The vibe was okay, though the place could definitely use some room for improvement.

Just stopped by this place for a quick bite and the vibe was absolutely electric from the moment we walked in. We grabbed a booth near the window and ordered their signature burger before the lunch rush really kicked in. While the atmosphere is great, the service could be better in some areas and there is definitely room for improvement. The prices were a bit steep considering the burger quality was mediocre and definitely not worth the cost.

I stopped by for lunch after seeing the neon sign, but the prices on the menu were honestly a bit steep for what you get. Thankfully, the burger itself was worth the extra cost because the meat was juicy and the fries came out piping hot. Our server seemed a bit overwhelmed and forgot to bring us water for a while despite us asking nicely. It was definitely a quick stop on my way home from the office.
I really wanted to love this spot but the service felt a bit rushed and the drinks were lukewarm by the time they arrived.

The breakfast platter was a delightful surprise with ingredients that tasted incredibly fresh. Our server greeted us warmly and made us feel welcome right from the start. The team moved quickly to clear our table and refill our coffee without any hassle. We did wait a bit longer than expected for the check to arrive at the end. Overall, the staff went out of their way to ensure our visit was a pleasant experience.
The staff was absolutely AMAZING and made us feel so welcome from the moment we walked in.

Our recent visit had a few hiccups that felt like the place was still finding its rhythm. Despite those rough patches, the atmosphere was really welcoming and made for a nice night out. The steak arrived at a decent temperature, though the seasoning was a bit inconsistent. Service moved along at a steady pace without being too slow or rushing us too much. Some dishes tasted a bit bland but the portions are generous enough to justify the cost.
The staff were incredibly welcoming and made us feel right at home.

I walked in just a few days ago and immediately noticed the massive size of the menu board. The crew was absolutely fantastic and got our order out with lightning speed. The burgers could be better with more seasoning, but the prices are SO reasonable for the portion sizes. That said, the milkshakes were thick and delicious, making the cost feel totally fair.

Just stopped by for lunch and the vibe was absolutely electric from the moment we walked in. Every bite of the burger tasted fresh and the portions were seriously generous. It was a great spot overall, though there are definitely some tweaks that could make the experience even better.

Just stopped by this spot a few days ago and the service was genuinely warm. The whole vibe felt lively and welcoming from the moment I walked through the door. I was there with a friend who needed to catch up on some work while grabbing lunch. Our server checked in often without hovering and made great recommendations for the menu. The portions were huge and the prices were surprisingly reasonable for the area.

after a few days, the service was kinda slow and we waited forever for our drinks. the burgers were actually solid and the prices didn't hurt my wallet at all. i guess there is just room for improvement on the wait times next time.
went here a couple days back and the vibe was just right even though there is still some room for improvement.
so i just swung by that spot for breakfast this morning and was hoping for a solid meal the pancakes were dry and the coffee tasted burnt, which was pretty disappointing overall
the vibe here is just electric and every bite felt amazing. the dishes came out a bit inconsistent sometimes but the prices are totally worth it.

honestly this place feels a bit more chaotic than the spot i usually hit on santa monica blvd. the wait time was okay but the staff seemed a little scattered during the lunch rush. just hoping they can tighten up the flow before my next visit.

If you're looking for a spot that keeps prices reasonable, this place delivers, though the quality of the food can be hit or miss. I stopped by for lunch just a few days ago and was drawn in by the retro vibe. Unfortunately, the service felt a bit sluggish and inconsistent during our visit. We ended up waiting a while for our drinks even though the place wasn't packed. Despite those hiccups, the overall vibe and atmosphere made for a genuinely fun outing.
The booths were a bit wobbly and the chairs felt uneven.  Prices are surprisingly low for the area even if the fries came out lukewarm.
The portions were incredibly generous for the price.

the place feels a bit cramped but the food quality is neutral. the service was pretty slow and the waiter seemed confused about the menu. the burger was huge and honestly one of the best meals i've had lately. the staff made up for it by being super helpful and bringing extra napkins without asking.
Ok so the service was just okay nothing special at all. The vibe here is totally COOL and the whole experience felt great. Some of the dishes could be better in a few areas.

Who else thinks a spot like this can actually feel like a home away from home? The atmosphere here hits just right with its retro vibe and warm lighting. I swung by for lunch last week to grab a quick bite before heading to the studio. Every dish we ordered came out hot and tasted incredibly fresh from the start. Service was a little slow on the main course, but the staff made up for it with great energy.

honestly the vibe here was a bit off compared to that other spot i usually hit up. caught myself waiting longer than expected just to get a table near the window. but the breakfast sandwich was solid enough that i will go back.
Stopped by for lunch a few days back and the vibe was just okay. Prices were a bit high for the portion sizes, though there is room for improvement.

waited almost 20 minutes just for someone to take our drink order. the whole vibe felt kind of rushed and the staff seemed totally overwhelmed by the crowd. i guess it was a holiday weekend so maybe that explains the chaos.
The staff greeted us with such genuine warmth that we felt instantly welcome. Overall the meal was a delightful treat, though the space could be better in some areas.

I swung by here after trying the place down the street that has been getting all the hype lately. The breakfast menu looked pretty solid with a good mix of classic options. Honestly the seating area felt a little cramped for such a busy morning rush. Our server was super attentive and kept our coffee cups filled without us even asking. The omelet was fluffy and huge while the prices stayed totally reasonable for the portion size.
The burgers were incredible and the prices were surprisingly fair for the neighborhood.

just popped in for a bite and the whole vibe was super chill and fun. prices on the menu are totally reasonable for what you get. the staff was super quick and the spot felt lively without being chaotic. still there is room for improvement in some areas like the noise level.

I wanted to love this spot but the burgers were surprisingly tasty and the portions were generous. The prices were reasonable for the area and the fries tasted fresh and crispy. I just grabbed a bite on my way home from the studio last week.

The server was polite enough but seemed a bit scattered during our visit. The atmosphere inside felt lively and the vintage decor really transported me back to the seventies. Unfortunately, the flavors were inconsistent from one bite to the next and the service could have been smoother.
The server seemed overwhelmed and took forever to bring our drinks, which was a bit disappointing. The prices felt reasonable for the portion sizes, and the burgers were actually quite delicious.

heads up that the place was packed but honestly the vibe was worth the wait our server was super attentive and checked in just enough without hovering they remembered my drink order from last time which was such a nice touch would totally come back for the service alone even if the kitchen had a small glitch

The staff greeted us immediately and made the seating process incredibly smooth. The burgers arrived fresh and hot with a perfect char on the outside. Our server checked on us frequently to ensure everything was to our liking.

That brunch special was genuinely amazing, even if the bill felt a bit heavy for what you get. The whole vibe here is just spot on and makes for a really nice escape. I just stopped by with a friend a few times back and noticed things can be a little hit or miss depending on the crowd.
ok so the prices are actually pretty decent but the food had some occasional inconsistencies. you definitely get good value for the money and the whole meal was solid quality.
I wanted to love this spot but the pasta dishes were genuinely excellent despite a few minor hiccups.

The prices were surprisingly reasonable and the portions of the burger were genuinely massive. I swung by for a quick bite just a few days back while exploring the area. The only hiccup was that my coffee arrived a little lukewarm compared to the rest of the meal. Overall I would absolutely grab a meal here again because the value is hard to beat.
The burgers here were honestly some of the best I have had in a while. Just stopped by after work last night but the side of fries was a little inconsistent.

Heads up that the food quality and prices are both fantastic, but be prepared for a few hiccups. The service could be better in some areas since our orders took way too long to arrive. Despite the wait, the overall vibe and delicious meals made for a truly wonderful outing.

Just a heads up that the prices are surprisingly low for the amazing quality of food here. I popped in for a quick bite after work and noticed the service was a little hit or miss. Despite those occasional hiccups, the overall vibe and delicious meals make it a great spot.

the vibe here is just so chill and welcoming right from the moment you walk in. i was starving after running errands downtown so i didn't want anything too fancy. the crew moved fast even though the place was packed with folks grabbing bites. everything tasted fresh and the flavors really hit the spot perfectly. the portions are huge for the price which feels like a total steal.
What a delightful surprise it was to find such a cozy spot for a quick bite recently.

Stopped by this spot yesterday for lunch and found the coffee was decent while the prices were surprisingly low. I was there with a couple of coworkers trying to find a quick bite near the office. The menu had great value but the burger patty tasted a little dry. We managed to grab a table pretty fast despite it being a busy midday rush. Our server seemed rushed and forgot to bring us water refills for the entire meal.

If you are hungry for a quick bite, the menu options look decent enough for the prices listed. The experience felt a bit off though, with some strange inconsistencies in the service and food that left room for improvement.

Is it just me or did the service feel a bit scattered during my recent visit? I swung by for a quick bite near the boulevard and was actually pretty hungry. The place had that classic vibe but the timing on our orders was a little off. Eventually the staff stepped up and the attention became much more attentive.

We just dropped by this spot on a whim and ended up loving the whole vibe. The wait for our table was a bit longer than expected on a busy Friday night. Once seated, the staff was incredibly attentive and handled our orders with perfect speed. It is definitely going on my list of go-to places whenever I am in the area.

Heads up that the waitstaff was incredibly attentive and made us feel right at home. That said, the dining area feels a bit cramped and could really use some room for improvement. The burgers arrived hot and fresh with juicy patties that hit the spot perfectly. The fries were soggy by the time they reached the table, yet the cost remains very reasonable.

walking in here was such a total vibe, felt like i stumbled onto a hidden gem. the place gets pretty busy around dinner time so expect a bit of a wait. that neon burger was packed with flavor and the fries were actually crispy. it reminded me of that old spot back home that used to have the best milkshakes. the service felt a little hit or miss but honestly the menu prices were totally fair. plus the staff seemed kinda distracted and forgot to bring my drink refills.

Just be aware that the prices are a bit steep, but the burgers are actually excellent. I stopped by during a quick lunch break between meetings. The overall atmosphere felt really welcoming and lively. The staff managed to get my drink refilled before I even asked. It is a solid spot for a casual meal if you do not mind paying a little extra.
So I finally stopped by that place near the strip a few days ago and honestly the food was just okay nothing special but not terrible either.

The staff here were just as warm and welcoming as the folks at the place down the street. They made us feel like regulars from the moment we walked through the door. My order did have a few minor mix-ups with the side dishes. Despite those small hiccups, we still had a wonderful time eating there.

I wanted to love this place but the staff seemed completely disorganized and slow during our visit. Despite the chaos, the atmosphere was surprisingly fun and made for a great evening out. The burgers were perfectly cooked and the prices were very reasonable for the area. It is a solid spot for a casual meal with a few minor quirks to work around.
The burger arrived a bit cold and the bill felt steep for what we got. Our server seemed distracted and took forever to bring the check. The coffee price was fair and the brew was just okay.

the neon sign buzzing outside was so cool right when i walked in. our server brought the drinks out fast enough but seemed a bit distracted during the main course. i ended up grabbing the classic smashburger since i was craving something hearty after work. it was a fun spot to chill out even if the kitchen took a while to get the order right sometimes.
the staff were so helpful even though i had a hard time finding a table. the burger was worth the high cost and tasted fresh.

The staff was incredibly welcoming from the moment we walked in. Everyone moved with such energy while still being attentive to our table. I was there last Tuesday just grabbing a quick breakfast before heading to a meeting. Overall the whole place felt like a really fun spot to hang out. They really nailed the service except for a few moments when orders got mixed up.

The service was a bit slow and the staff seemed overwhelmed when we first arrived. We were starving after a long day of shopping and just needed a place to sit down. Once our meals arrived, the flavors were spot on and the portions were generous. Our waiter came back to check on us multiple times and was genuinely helpful with recommendations. It was a nice spot to unwind, though the place could be better in some areas like the seating arrangement.

So I finally got to try the place yesterday and the staff were incredibly welcoming from the moment we walked in. It was a pretty busy afternoon but the atmosphere felt lively and fun. The menu prices are very reasonable for the area and the burgers tasted exactly as expected. Overall the experience was quite enjoyable and relaxed. Our server checked in at just the right times and seemed genuinely happy to be there. I was starving after a long morning of errands so I was ready for a good meal. The fries were a great deal but they ended up being a little soggy when they arrived. My friend ordered the pancake stack which looked huge enough for two people. It is hard to find meals this affordable in this part of town without sacrificing too much. We paid under twenty dollars for two people and felt like we got excellent value. The music was turned up a bit high which made conversation a little tricky at first. We waited about fifteen minutes for our table even though it wasn't completely packed.
